name: Kirloskar Industries Limited
summary: Kirloskar Industries Limited manufactures and sells iron castings in India. It also manufactures steel and seamless tubes, cylinder tubes, and components and engineering steels. In addition, the company provides real estate development and leasing services; owns real estate properties that include lands and buildings, apartments, and offices; and invests in properties and securities. The company was formerly known as Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd and changed its name to Kirloskar Industries Limited in March 2010. Kirloskar Industries Limited was founded in 1888 and is based in Pune, India.
